name: @juli-os/routing
description: juli-os L4 layer: multi-agent dispatch decisions — declarative agent routing, busy-diversion, sender-domain claims, and a pluggable judgment gateway. Pure functions over injected facts.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/juli-routing.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/juli-routing.js && chmod +x dist/juli-routing.js && python3 scripts/postbuild.py
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.decideRoute !== 'function' || typeof m.routeTask !== 'function') process.exit(1); console.log('DIST SMOKE OK'); })"
